_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Equipment History Data Package
summary: Provides an accurate history for each vehicle equipment to be delivered, applicable to security/Aerospace Vehicular Equipment related to Air Force Satellite Programs.
use_relationship:
To provide an accurate history for each vehicle equipment to be delivered.

This Data Package is related to the following Data Item Descriptions (DIDs):

Failure Data and Traceability Record, DI-RELI-80807
Failure Analysis and Corrective Action Report, DI-SESS-81315A

This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to communicate security/Aerospace Vehicular Equipment related to Air Force Satellite Programs. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The following format requirements shall apply:

children.title: The pages shall be prepared (or duplicated)
children.content: in non-fading ink 8"x10 1/2" or 8 1/2" x 11" paper. Subject to prior government approval, copies of information prepared to other sizes may be acceptable.

children.title: The document shall be enclosed in a durable plastic
children.content: three-ring binder. The security classification of the document shall appear at the top and bottom of both the front and back cover. Security classifications shall appear on all other pages as applicable.

children.title: The title page shall contain
Title of the document, equipment nomenclatures, and serial number
Name and signature of the person responsible for compiling the document
Name of the preparing activity, contract number and date compilation
A Table of Contents shall follow the Title Page
A separate package conforming to above instruction
children.content: shall be prepared for retrofit or modification actions. This package will show previous operating time from original package.

children.title: Instructions for Entering Data in the Operating Time Log (Fig. 1)
DATE
START TIME
STOP TIME
TOTAL TIME OF TEST
CUMULATIVE TOTAL TIME OF TEST
children.content: A running total of all time spent testing the device. It is obtained by adding the previous cumulative total (if any) to the total time for that test.

children.title: REMARKS
children.content: To be used to identify the test being reported; problems encountered during the test; or other such information.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The data package shall include the following information for the equipment identified in the Statement of Work (SOW):

children.title: Section 1.1 shall contain the operating time log for the equipment (see Fig. 1)
children.content: Section 1.2 shall contain a complete list of boards and subassemblies incorporated in the equipment. This list shall show parts, number, type, location, serial number and traceability information, verified by Quality Assurance. Section 1.3 shall contain a Record sheet of Permuter showing short title, edition and register installed, verified by Quality Assurance. This sheet shall be used to record any changes of Permuters.

children.title: Section 2 shall contain the final assembly manufacturing order
Section 3 shall contain records of all failures of boards, subassemblies or equipment and the result of a failure analysis
Section 4 shall contain records of all non-conforming material reports (Material Review Board Reports), discrepancy reports and dispositions
Section 5 shall contain all electrical test data sheets for the major subassemblies (Power Converter, etc.) and the end item
children.content: Circuit card test data will not be included. Procedures (except for special tests) shall not be included.

children.title: Section 6 shall contain final environmental test data sheets including but not limited to
Time/Temperature charts for all thermal and thermal/vacuum tests
Spectrum chart for all vibrations tests
Specimen test results data sheets
Section 7 shall contain Quality Assurance check sheets
children.content: The required data shall contain but not limited to:

children.title: Record of lowest operating voltage of the equipment and current drain at 22, 28, and 33 volts DC
Record of internal processing time and internal processing and output time (as applicable)
This section will not contain quality plans, etc
Section 8 shall contain any supplemental information which provides equipment history
children.content: This shall include but not limited to:

children.title: Copies of correspondence concerning waivers, deviations, engineering change proposals, special tests, etc
Record of special tests and results
List of waivers, deviations, and ECPs
Section 9 shall contain blank operating time log forms for subsequent use
children.content: These forms shall be prepared in accordance with figure 1 of this DID.
